mapper.select: SELECT v.mcp_server_version_id AS version_id, v.version_no, v.status, v.revision, v.published_at, v.last_update_time, ( v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.version_no = MAX(v.version_no) FILTER (WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED') OVER () ) AS current FROM squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version v WHERE v.mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC

SELECT v.mcp_server_version_id, s.mcp_server_id, s.server_code, s.server_name, v.version_no, (v.version_no = MAX(v.version_no) OVER (PARTITION BY v.mcp_server_id)) AS latest FROM squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version v JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server s ON s.mcp_server_id = v.mcp_server_id WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY s.server_code, v.version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version SET transport_type = #{transportType}, endpoint = #{endpoint}, credential_ref = #{credentialRef}, request_headers = #{requestHeaders, typeHandler=com.agentsquad.squad.v2.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, timeout_ms = #{timeoutMs}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} AND mcp_server_version_id = #{mcpServerVersionId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND revision = #{revision}
